detected_issue: Possible visible injury or medical concern detected from the provided image.
first_aid: Stop activity and keep the injured area still.
Apply pressure to bleeding with sterile gauze or clean cloth.
Use a cold pack wrapped in cloth for swelling, 15-20 minutes at a time.
Seek same-day medical advice if pain, swelling, or bleeding persists.
red_flags: Difficulty breathing, confusion, fainting, or chest pain
Rapidly worsening pain, swelling, fever, or spreading redness
recommended_action: Monitor closely and consult a clinician if symptoms worsen.
disclaimer: RapidAid AI provides AI-assisted guidance only and is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis or emergency services. If symptoms are severe, worsening, or life-threatening, call local emergency services immediately.
